capabilities: race from a start note to a target note by clicking links only
track time, click count, and par for each race
play built-in tracks on logic fallacies, European geography, and the Bible
run daily challenges with a shared race and streak counter
copy a spoiler-free Wordle-style result to the clipboard
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. main.js is about 5 MB because track texts are bundled for offline use; mobile support is untested. A one-time 'Buy me a coffee' note appears on the result screen after the 5th finished race; no third-party ads and no network use.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to play link-based navigation games or to see in a playful way how well connected your own notes are.
summary: Wiki-race game that picks a start and target note in your vault and times you as you get from one to the other by clicking links only.
